title: RequirementSchema
description: Defines the schema to exchange requirements related information. [req("exchange.requirements.schema")]

origin.description: Optional base origin of the requirements in this entry. e.g. specific branch or commit from a git repository

product_id.description: Optional product ID to specify the product the requirements are part of. If this field is not set, the ID of the product whose configuration included this schema is used.

properties.description:
Optional properties related to all requirements in this entry.

**Note:** If a requirement sets a property key directly, the value set at the requirement will be taken.

Requirement.description: This struct defines the information *mantra* stores about a requirement. [req("req")]

children.description: Optional list of child requirement relations. [req("req.hierarchy.explicit_children")]

deprecated.description:
true: Marks the requirement to be deprecated.

**Note:** All potential children of such a requirement are also marked as deprecated. [req("req.deprecated")]

exclude.description:
true: Instructs mantra to exclude the requirement for the product it is mapped to.

**Note:** All potential children of such a requirement will also be excluded. [req("req.exclude")]

manual_verification.description:
true: Marks the requirement to require manual verification.

**Note:** All potential children of such a requirement are also marked to require manual verification. [req("req.manual")]

optional.description:
true: Instructs mantra to treat the requirement for the product as optional.

**Note:** All potential children of such a requirement are also marked as optional. [req("req.optional")]

origin.description: Origin where the requirement is defined at. [req("req.origin")]

parents.description: Optional list of parent requirement relations. [req("req.hierarchy.mult_parents")]

properties.description: List of custom properties of a requirement. [req("req.properties")]

replaces.description: Optional list of requirements that this requirement replaces. Replacing a requirement is only possible inside the same product and marks replaced requirements as *deprecated*.

RequirementRelation.description: This struct defines the relation between requirements.

aspect.description: Optional aspect that is covered by this relation.

product_id.description: ID of the product the related requirement is defined in. If `None`, the related requirement is assumed to be in the same product.
